nodes.description: Example: an LRU cache never grows beyond its generated capacity.

nodes.description: The thread scheduler adds randomness the test author does not control.

nodes.description: Every generated execution is judged against the property we wrote first.

nodes.label: Shrink the failure
nodes.description: Reduce the failing case to the smallest useful explanation of the bug.

nodes.label: Replay + report
nodes.description: A minimal, reproducible failure turns research into an actionable engineering result.
